scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ledgermate/web" "npm run dev -w @ledgermate/api"
scripts.test:api: node automation/scripts/clean-suite-results.mjs api && ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=automation/reports/allure-results/api playwright test automation/api && node automation/scripts/snapshot-results.mjs api
scripts.test:ui: node automation/scripts/clean-suite-results.mjs ui && ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=automation/reports/allure-results/ui playwright test automation/ui && node automation/scripts/snapshot-results.mjs ui
scripts.test:cucumber: node automation/scripts/clean-suite-results.mjs bdd && node automation/scripts/run-with-services.mjs -- npm run test:cucumber:raw && node automation/scripts/snapshot-results.mjs bdd
scripts.test:automation: npm run allure:prepare && npm run test:inventory && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:cucumber
scripts.test:complete: npm run test:automation && npm run performance:test && npm run performance:report && npm run allure:generate
